players.product: Faraday rotator plates, optical crystals (incl. TSAG magneto-optical crystals) and precision optics (crystal growth, precision optical processing, coating, device integration)

quarterly_data.signal: Vice chairman and general manager Chen Qiuhua (2025 annual results briefing): the 2026 plan keeps a 'crystal + optics + devices' one-stop laser solution; on top of a stable industrial nanosecond-UV and fiber-laser base it will focus on ultrafast laser applications (including disk lasers) and 266nm deep-UV applications related to semiconductor manufacturing, carry out R&D and mass production of the diffraction gratings needed for next-generation WSS, and keep expanding high-value complex optically-contacted optical assemblies and crystals for optical communications. Asked about Zhiqi Photonics' annual output target, he said it will strive for relatively fast growth depending on orders and development progress.
